evidence.V1: Lollipop broadleaf tree reads clearly in front, 3/4 and silhouette (lobed canopy on a straight trunk); top view is a lumpy green blob, acceptable for a canopy.
evidence.V2: Big canopy and medium trunk read, but the small tier is missing: the two branches are buried (branch-fork close-up shows only a V-notch at the trunk top, a tiny stub in the front view) and the canopy is one shell with soft bulges.
evidence.V3: Canopy lobes are pleasantly cloud-like, but the trunk is a stiff straight near-square tube with no taper or root flare beyond a thin dark collar; partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Canopy is a smooth fused shell (fine), but the trunk shows hard near-square corners and a flat sock-like base band with a sharp step (trunk-base close-up); inconsistent treatment.
evidence.V5: Canopy shows a faint quad-grid lattice/checker in the studio shading (canopy close-up, frost and autumn colourways) and the trunk side has a long vertical shading crease; minor but visible.
evidence.V6: Foliage green in 2-3 values plus bark brown in two values; colourways (autumn, frost) swap cleanly.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and nature palette fit, but the grid-patterned canopy shading and boxy trunk differ from the smooth-shell kit look.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only part for walk-through canopies), CanTouch off, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Quad-grid lattice pattern visible across the canopy shading
Vertical shading crease along the trunk
